title: The tariff classification of Eltesol TSX/A (para toluenesulphonic acid monohydrate CAS# 6192-52-5) from France.
text:
NY 883790
                             March 24, 1993

CLA-2-29:S:N:N7:239 883790  

CATEGORY:  Classification

TARIFF NO.: 2904.10.3700  

Mr. Mark Huggard
Albright & Wilson
P.O. Box 26229
Richmond, Virginia 23260-6229

RE:  The tariff classification of Eltesol TSX/A (para toluene
sulphonic acid monohydrate CAS# 6192-52-5) from France.

Dear Mr. Huggard:

     In your letter dated February 23, 1993, you requested a
tariff classification ruling.         

     The applicable subheading for Eltesol TSK/A will be
2904.10.3700, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States
(HTS), which provides for other sulfonated, nitrated or
nitrosated derivatives of hydrocarbons, whether or not
halogenated.  The rate of duty will be 3.7 cents per kilogram
plus 15.9 percent ad valorem.

     The United States Customs Service does not have the
authority to act on a request for tariff relief.  Any request for
tariff relief should be directed to the Congress of the United
States in Washington D.C.   

     This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Section
177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).

     A copy of this ruling letter should be attached to the entry
documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If the
documents have been filed without a copy, this ruling should be
brought to the attention of the Customs officer handling the
transaction.

                                   Sincerely,

                                   
  
                                   Jean F. Maguire
                                   Area Director
                                   New York Seaport
